question: Does high originally filed inventory growth relative to sales growth in the then-disclosed four-name SOXX basket predict weaker next-63-session SOXX open-to-open price returns beyond trailing trend/volatility and raw four-name weight?
hypothesis_sign: negative candidate coefficient on inventory-minus-sales log growth

mechanism_sources.role: stock-level inventory-change negative future abnormal-return lead, not ETF proof
manufacturing-firm abnormal inventory growth relative to sales associated with weaker long-term returns, not semiconductor ETF proof

price_source.source_description: Previously qualified single-SOXX published-affine extension, split-adjusted and bitwise equal to the canonical 2010+ overlap. Retrospective affine does not establish total return or historical PIT; only price-return information labels and scale-invariant trailing-return controls are used.

signal.decision_schedule: first native Qlib session of each calendar month
signal.source_eligibility: every then-disclosed member among NVDA,TSM,UMC,ASX must have one original own-period comparable pair available by decision session and no older than 550 calendar days; exclude the three early NVDA months
signal.basket_aggregation: sum over eligible fund-disclosed four-name holdings of raw weight_pct/100 times issuer_term; never renormalize missing or absent basket weight
signal.coverage_control: sum raw weight_pct/100 of those four names; no member means zero weight, an active but missing member excludes the month
signal.availability: original filing values first usable on native Qlib session strictly after filed date, N-PORT basket only after its filing date

target.decision_information_time: after decision-session open; next session open is earliest hypothetical entry
target.label: log(SOXX open at decision index+64 / SOXX open at decision index+1)
trailing_controls: sample standard deviation of 20 daily open-to-open log returns ending at t
target.primary_training: monthly decisions from 2020-03-01 through 2023-12-31 with label maturity strictly before first held decision
target.partial_2026: diagnostic only, never candidate selection or primary gate

model.baseline: Ridge alpha=10.0 with intercept on three standardized controls
model.candidate: same Ridge alpha=10.0 plus standardized inventory-sales mismatch
model.scaler: fit mean and population standard deviation on eligible training decisions only; zero-variance column invalidates the screen

information_gate.bootstrap: stationary bootstrap of held monthly paired loss differences, mean block 3 observations, 10000 draws, seed 20261014, lower quantile alpha=0.025/15 strictly positive
information_gate.interpretation: information-only development screen; no SOXX wealth, cost/risk/annual/rolling or independent forward promotion follows

stops: Any source Recorder, price-provider file, calendar or code/notebook identity differs before market read.

Missing/duplicate source pair, active disclosed member without a valid pair, invalid price rows, immature label or insufficient held months are explicit exclusions/needs_data, never filled from future information.
No threshold/window/sign/alpha refit or second candidate after the held result.
Positive information, if any, is reused historical development only and cannot be called stable fee-net SOXX excess.
outputs: Executable notebook, DatasetH/Recorder with exact source and price identities, fixed forecasts and paired loss rows in Recorder
Slim summary and Chinese conclusion with train/held counts, yearly held differences, coefficient sign, bootstrap gate and non-promotion

pre_market_source_correction.reason: Official iShares 3-for-1 SOXX split effective March 2024 falls inside fixed held interval; raw NONE open-to-open would count the corporate action as a return. Select already-qualified split-adjusted published-affine price plane before any market value read or model fit.
